title: A conscious universe need not think or act

statements.text: Cosmopsychism is not pantheism or a world-soul. As the micropsychist gives electrons experience without thought, the cosmopsychist can give the universe experience without thought or agency, and explaining ordinary biological consciousness gives little reason to ascribe intelligence to the cosmos.

sources.quote: Cosmopsychism is not to be confused with pantheism: the view that the universe is God.
it is unlikely that one will end up ascribing intelligence or agency to the cosmos
